rationale: Build on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline with a compact asymmetric curriculum: the anchor carry path ramps in earlier while the recurrent block rewrite ramps in later. The hypothesis is that earlier anchor transport stabilizes late-phase state reuse and preserves the winning reverse-tail structure, while delaying the heavier recurrent rewrite reduces early optimization noise and quantization drift under the 600s Mac-mini budget.
title: Carry-Lead Reverse-Tail Curriculum
